verdict.rationale: Docs show Skills can be created/uploaded/managed via a dedicated Skills API and invoked in the Messages API via the `container` parameter (up to 20 skills per request), paralleling the UI/Claude Code experience of adding SKILL.md files and invoking via slash commands; skills are also noted as available to Claude.ai paid plans, suggesting cross-surface parity for core skill creation/use. However there's no explicit documentation confirming full feature parity (e.g., automatic discovery/triggering behavior, plugin marketplaces, agent teams, or Claude Code-specific UX like `/run`/`/verify` are not shown as API-equivalent), and community comments focus on triggering reliability rather than API/UI parity. Missing for 10: explicit statement/confirmation that all UI-exposed skill behaviors (auto-discovery, marketplaces, Code-specific commands) are equally achievable via API, and independent verification of parity.
